_note: Client-mapping test: maps each meeting to a workstream client key based ONLY on known_participants email domains (SKILL.md Rule 1) -- not title/folder/summary. tie_break_rule: Ambiguous meetings (participants spanning more than one CLIENT_DOMAINS entry) map to the client key of the alphabetically-first matching domain STRING (not the client key string). goengen.com < natera.com alphabetically, so a meeting with both domains present maps to 'engen'. This rule is arbitrary but pinned and deterministic -- see quarantine_lib.map_client().
